answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 34931 Country: India Title: Sajdah missed in Namaz Question: In Ramdan taravih while reading Quran a sajdah was missed while compulsory sajda is required. Sajda Sahu was also not done so is the salah valid? Answer ID: 34931 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2132/1233/H=1432) Your salah was not valid; rather had you done sajdah sahv then too your salah was not valid because both the sajdahs are fardh. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
